title: prd.json — Product Requirements Document
description: Schema for the prd.json file consumed by tdd.sh to track TDD task progress.

project.description: Project identifier in snake_case, matching the consuming repo's name.

description.description: Free-text summary of the project purpose.

tasks.description: Ordered list of TDD tasks. The orchestrator works through tasks whose gold field is 'current'.

description.description: Detailed description of the task's scope and intent.

acceptance_criteria.description: Concrete, testable conditions that define when the task is complete.

gold.description: Task state machine: 'current' (being worked), 'done' (completed), 'backlog' (not yet started).

passes.description: Updated each acceptance run: true if acceptance criteria are met, false otherwise.

evaluation_command.description: Shell command to evaluate this task's acceptance criteria, typically a docker exec invocation running a specific test file.

rationale.description: Rationale explaining why the task is in its current gold/passes state. Each element corresponds to a TDD cycle or decision point.

recommendation.description: Recommended next actions for the task. Each element corresponds to a TDD cycle or decision point.

notes.description: Free-text field for observations, blockers, or decisions recorded during TDD cycles.
